card.name: Disclaimer and credit statements on web pages
card.fires_on: Verbs and small linking words inside website disclaimers, copyright notices and publication credits, such as "This article is", "Advertising does not" and "This post was".

modes.description: Linking words inside disclaimers that say what an article or ad is or is not meant to be.
